title: Pokemon Gaia (v3.2)
sources: The ROM itself (Gaia v3.2, FireRed base): region map section names (each place resolves to a section with maps) and trainer names, teams and levels, read on the PC with throwaway tools
mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia: walkthrough parts, Mega Stone list, Pokédex
pokuniverse.com: Pokémon Gaia game guide (field moves, rival fights)
The Gaia team's official evolution-changes spreadsheet (docs.google.com, 1kNl2L2t...)
gamebrew.org: Pokemon Gaia Version (features, v3.2 change list)
mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia/walkthrough (parts 1-22), /mega-stones and /tms-hms: story order, gifts, trades, puzzles, item spots
Allen Chingonzoh: Pokemon Gaia v3.2 walkthrough (emulatorhacks.com, 2021): Rayquaza and Deoxys levels, Rimewood Forest, Showtan, Cynjo, Battle Marsh bosses
The ROM itself: the hidden items on its maps (read with the same throwaway tools)

milestones.name: Rival: first battle (Archan Tunnel)
milestones.tips: Professor Redwood gives Turtwig, Chimchar or Piplup in the Celanto Town library; the rival (default name Coulter) takes the one strong against yours and waits at the tunnel with it at Lv 5. A Clefairy sits in a grotto inside the tunnel.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: Gym 1: Fernando
milestones.badge_note: Mystic Badge; TM Charming Cry. Cut comes from the Day-Care man in Seros.
milestones.tips: Fairy types: Clefairy, Ralts, Jigglypuff (Lv 11-13). Poison and Steel moves hit them hard; Fire and Steel types resist their Fairy moves. He runs off to Wisp Forest and hands over the badge there.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: New Elders at the Aerous Museum
milestones.tips: Redwood sends you to find Herschel at the museum. A fake clerk and two masked grunts block the stairs (Lv 14-15), then a New Elders grunt (Omanyte). Herschel then joins you at the west gate and Redwood hands over Rock Smash in the Archan Tunnel.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 3

milestones.name: Aerous Art Club: Vincent
milestones.tips: Opens after the museum. Four Painters and Art Master Vincent use only Smeargle (six of them, Lv 16-18), each with different moves. Keep a party slot free: the prize is the game's only Eevee, as an Egg.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 3

milestones.name: Rival at the Nestpine gym
milestones.tips: At the gym door: Makuhita, Roggenrola, Eevee, Swablu, Monferno (Lv 20-23) (or the Lv 22 version without Eevee). He gives you the EXP Share afterwards.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; pokuniverse.com Gaia game guide

milestones.name: Gym 2: Aria
milestones.badge_note: Plume Badge (name from one low-quality site).
milestones.tips: Flying types: Vullaby, Gligar, Chatot (Lv 21-23). Electric, Ice and Rock moves; Gligar takes four times from Ice.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: New Elders: Eunice (Frostbite Cave)
milestones.tips: Elder Knight Eunice waits on 6F after one of her grunts (Baltoy, Diggersby, Binacle, Lv 20-21): Snover, Froslass, Noctowl, Amaura (Lv 24-26). Fire, Fighting, Rock and Steel moves. Since 3.2 the fight starts when you talk to her or walk past.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 5; gamebrew.org: Pokemon Gaia

milestones.name: New Elders at Ignis Roost and Apex Temple
milestones.tips: Up Windmist Summit (the rival heals you at the top), four grunts on Ignis Roost and three more fights in the temple, one a double (Anorith, Lileep). Enoch escapes without a fight; read the book at the back and take it to Redwood, who then opens Nina's gym.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia parts 5-6

milestones.name: Gym 3: Nina
milestones.tips: Fire types: Pignite, Magmar, Heatmor, Camerupt (Lv 26-28). Water and Ground moves; Camerupt takes four times from Water.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: Belle (Sabulo Tower)
milestones.tips: Sabulo Tower is a gym in all but name: Experts Nicholi (Normal) and Maya (Grass), Ace Trainers Atsushi (Fire) and Mikel (Water), Expert Agem (Dragon, Lv 32), then Belle: Heracross, Manectric, Sableye, Mawile, Audino (Lv 30-32), Audino Mega Evolving. Lv 30 recommended. Win the Mega Ring.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 7; pokuniverse.com Gaia game guide

milestones.name: New Elders: Enoch (Sabulo Cave)
milestones.tips: After the Mega Ring, Regirock appears at the cave mouth: two grunts (Lv 28), then Enoch: Tyrantrum, Diggersby, Golurk, Aerodactyl (Lv 30-32). Water and Ice moves; Aerodactyl and Tyrantrum carry Ancient Power. He still takes Regirock. The rival then hands you Surf, and Belle gives the second starter (a Kanto one weak to yours, with its Mega Stone).
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 7

milestones.name: Gym 4: Vernon
milestones.tips: Bug types with a Mega Beedrill: Shuckle, Scizor, Masquerain, Beedrill (Lv 34-36). Fire, Flying and Rock moves; Shuckle and Scizor are walls (Scizor takes four times from Fire).
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: Rival: Battle Marsh
milestones.tips: After Vernon he gives you the Gas Mask for Telmurk Swamp, then waits outside the Battle Marsh Facility and heals you first: Hariyama, Boldore, Rotom, Altaria, an Eeveelution and his starter (Lv 34-36).
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia parts 9-10

milestones.name: Mighty Mightyenas street thugs
milestones.tips: Akuto's gang fights you on Telmurk's streets if you talk to them: Rufio, Tiago, Gonzo and Bosko, each with a Mightyena (Lv 33). The house robbery to the northwest starts the boss fight.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 11

milestones.name: Mighty Mightyenas: Boss Akuto
milestones.tips: The Telmurk street gang's thugs (Lv 33-37) lead to their boss: Lairon, Bouffalant, Mightyena (Lv 37-39). Fighting and Fairy moves. Akuto gives Fly afterwards.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; pokuniverse.com Gaia game guide

milestones.name: Gym 5: Sid
milestones.badge_note: Pollution Badge (name unconfirmed); TM Sludge Bomb.
milestones.tips: Poison types with a Mega Venusaur: Arbok, Drapion, Nidoking, Venusaur (Lv 40-42). Psychic and Ground moves; Drapion is part Dark (Ground only).
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: New Elders in the Ferre Ruins
milestones.tips: Herschel gives Rock Climb at the Underground Path exit. No healing from Telmurk to Precimos: the ruins hold eight grunts in a row (fossil Pokémon, Bronzong, Claydol, Mamoswine; Lv 36-39). Bring potions; the old man in the Outskirts gives five Fresh Water.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 12

milestones.name: New Elders: Ezekiel (Ferre Ruins)
milestones.tips: Ezekiel at the bottom of the ruins, behind a Braille door (count the stones in each pool: 4519): Skarmory, Doublade, Claydol, Cradily, Aggron (Lv 42-45, Mega Aggron). Fire and Ground moves; Fighting for Aggron. He still takes Registeel.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 12

milestones.name: Gym 6: Will
milestones.badge_note: Focus Badge (name unconfirmed); TM Calm Mind.
milestones.tips: Psychic types with a Mega Slowbro: Xatu, Jynx, Exeggutor, Metagross, Slowbro (Lv 42-44). Dark, Ghost and Bug moves; Metagross is part Steel (Fire, Ground).
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: Burglars in the Precimos Hotel
milestones.tips: After Will, the hotel's suites are full of burglars. Beat all eight to get past Jordon (Gourgeist, Lv 42), then their leader Celso (Exploud, Noivern, Lv 41). The sleeping guest gives you the Tablet Idol to take to Atsail City.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 13

milestones.name: Rival outside the Precimos hotel
milestones.tips: Hariyama, Gigalith, Vaporeon, Rotom, Altaria, Infernape (Lv 43-45).
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; pokuniverse.com Gaia game guide

milestones.name: Scientist Mallard (Cosmic Caverns)
milestones.tips: On the way to Edashore: Nurse Mercy (Blissey, Lv 43) heals you after a win, and across the lake Scientist Mallard has the whole Porygon line (Lv 40). The Hex Maniac in chamber C swaps a Sableye sighting for Sablenite.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 14

milestones.name: Gym 7: Marina
milestones.tips: Water types with a Mega Gyarados: Qwilfish, Jellicent, Kingdra, Pelipper, Gyarados (Lv 46-48). Electric moves above all (Gyarados and Pelipper take four times).
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: Atsail Cold Storage
milestones.tips: Three Workers (Ice and Fighting types, Lv 41-42). After Marina the rival follows a grunt here; the Forklift Key is in the hay of the first Loamas Fields barn. The dark basement holds 10 Relic Balls and a Rare Candy, and the New Elders' meeting.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia parts 16-17

milestones.name: New Elders: Morgana
milestones.tips: The Forklift Key opens the Cold Storage basement; Redwood and Marina then take you to Apex Temple, where the Elder Sage herself fights: Mismagius, Sigilyph, Drapion, Houndoom, Gengar (Lv 47-49, Mega Gengar). Lv 50 advised. Dark and Ghost moves; Ground for Drapion and Houndoom.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 17

milestones.name: Deoxys (Cosmic Caverns)
milestones.tips: Once you have Strength, fill the six holes with boulders in the Cosmic Caverns south of Edashore Reach, then follow the black triangle until it shatters: Deoxys, Lv 50, one chance only.
milestones.source: Allen Chingonzoh's Gaia v3.2 walkthrough (emulatorhacks.com)

milestones.name: Loamas Fields: Jax and Cassy
milestones.tips: A double battle with Gourgeist and Grumpig (Lv 44) in front of a field; Rancher Chuck's Bouffalant and Miltank on the farm road. Feed Pa's five Mareep on the way for TM X-Scissor.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 18

milestones.name: The Winston family gauntlet
milestones.tips: Four battles in a row with no healing (Lv 45, each with an Eeveelution). The head of the family pays P10,000 when you win.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 18

milestones.name: Gym 8: Richter
milestones.tips: Ground types with a Mega Garchomp: Hippowdon, Gastrodon, Excadrill, Dugtrio, Garchomp (Lv 50-52). Water, Grass and Ice; Garchomp takes four times from Ice.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: Rival: Ikos Canyon
milestones.tips: In the sandstorm on the way to Ikos Town, with a Mega Altaria now: Hariyama, Gigalith, Rotom, Altaria, an Eeveelution and his starter (Lv 49-51). Most of his team takes sandstorm damage too.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 19

milestones.name: New Elders in Ignis Valley
milestones.tips: Past the Strength boulder near Windmist's east gate: four grunts and a final double (Abomasnow, Ursaring), all Lv 47-48.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 20

milestones.name: Morgana at the Key Tablet
milestones.tips: Mismagius, Sigilyph, Drapion, Houndoom, Gengar (Mega) and a Salamence that knows Molten Raze (Lv 52-54). She opens the tablet anyway; Herschel then sends you after the three Idol Pieces.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 20

milestones.name: Eunice at the Relicanth Tablet
milestones.tips: Herschel's Alakazam teleports you. Aurorus, Froslass, Noctowl, Gastrodon, Abomasnow (Lv 52-54, Mega Abomasnow). Fire, Fighting, Steel and Rock moves.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 20

milestones.name: Enoch at the Tangrowth Tablet
milestones.tips: In the Archan Tunnel: Tyrantrum, Golurk, Diggersby, Machamp, Aerodactyl (Lv 52-54, Mega Aerodactyl). Water, Ice and Steel moves.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 20

milestones.name: Ezekiel at the Lileep Tablet
milestones.tips: Deep in Nemesis Cave: Skarmory, Aegislash, Claydol, Cradily, Aggron (Lv 52-54, Mega Aggron). Fire and Ground; Fighting for Aggron. The three pieces make a new Tablet Idol.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 20

milestones.name: Morgana in the Chamber of Gaia
milestones.tips: Herschel opens the Key Tablet with Molten Raze. Morgana first: Mismagius, Sigilyph, Drapion, Houndoom, Gengar (Lv 55-57); then she calls the golems: Regirock, Regice, Registeel (Lv 55) and Regigigas (Lv 57). Fighting moves for Regigigas. Herschel then gives Waterfall.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 20

milestones.name: Rayquaza (Emerald Peak)
milestones.tips: Up the waterfall on Nestpine Climb (needs Waterfall) into Emerald Peak; Rayquaza (Lv 70, Rest, ExtremeSpeed, Dragon Pulse, Dragon Dance) waits at the top. TM41 Dragon Dance is on 1F. Can be done before the league.
milestones.source: Allen Chingonzoh's Gaia v3.2 walkthrough (emulatorhacks.com); mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia /tms-hms

milestones.name: Rival: Victory Falls
milestones.tips: The last rival fight before the climb: Hariyama, Gigalith, Vaporeon, Rotom, Altaria, Infernape (Lv 53-55).
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; pokuniverse.com Gaia game guide

milestones.name: Elite Four: Nicola
milestones.tips: Fought in any order; a loss restarts all four. Galvantula, Magnezone, Electivire, Eelektross, Lanturn, Manectric (Lv 56-58). Ground moves (Lanturn: Grass; Eelektross has Levitate, so no Ground).
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 22

milestones.name: Elite Four: Knight
milestones.tips: Fought in any order; a loss restarts all four. Bisharp, Sharpedo, Weavile, Malamar, Honchkrow, Absol (Lv 56-58). Fighting, Bug and Fairy moves.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: Elite Four: Kara
milestones.tips: Fought in any order; a loss restarts all four. Mienshao, Hawlucha, Medicham, Scrafty, Lucario, Blaziken (Lv 56-58). Psychic, Flying and Fairy moves.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: Elite Four: Leif
milestones.tips: Fought in any order; a loss restarts all four. Ludicolo, Ferrothorn, Whimsicott, Amoonguss, Trevenant, Sceptile (Lv 56-58). Fire, Flying, Ice and Poison moves.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: Champion Herschel
milestones.tips: A mixed team with a Mega Salamence: Wailord, Yanmega, Mamoswine, Tangrowth, Alakazam, Salamence (Lv 58-60). Ice for Salamence and Yanmega, Fire for Mamoswine and Tangrowth, Electric or Grass for Wailord.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: The Rimewood Forest monster
milestones.tips: After the league the Black Belt on Windmist Summit lets you into the forest (bring Cut). The monster is a wild Abomasnow (Lv 40) upset by the loggers; the lumberjack then gives a Life Orb, and Abomasite lies just west.
milestones.source: Allen Chingonzoh's Gaia v3.2 walkthrough (emulatorhacks.com)

milestones.name: Post-game: Akuto's rematch
milestones.tips: In the Telmurk Game Corner's back room after the New Elders are gone: Mightyena, Scrafty, Staraptor, Bouffalant, Aggron, Mightyena (Lv 52-54), with a Full Restore.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; Allen Chingonzoh's Gaia v3.2 walkthrough (emulatorhacks.com)

milestones.name: Secret trainer Showtan
milestones.tips: Behind the Aerous City museum wall (code 1104): Weedle, Sigilyph, Slowbro, Togekiss, Shuckle, Drapion (Lv 60).
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

milestones.name: Cynjo at the Game Freak office
milestones.tips: One of the hack's makers waits on the Office Tower's 4F after the New Elders are gone. The ROM's team: Cyndaquil, Gliscor, Machamp, Escavalier, Swampert and a Lv 65 Dialga.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; Allen Chingonzoh's Gaia v3.2 walkthrough (emulatorhacks.com)

milestones.name: Battle Marsh tournament bosses
milestones.tips: Upstairs in the facility: three Pokémon at Lv 50, no items in battle, healing between rounds. A Marsh Boss every 20 wins (Iris, Lister, Christos, Amy), and founder Shinoya after 100.
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; Allen Chingonzoh's Gaia v3.2 walkthrough (emulatorhacks.com)

milestones.name: Post-game: leader and league rematches
milestones.tips: The ROM has Lv 67 teams for all eight leaders, Lv 68 for the Elite Four and Lv 75 for Herschel. The Battle Marsh is a Battle Maison-style facility (three Pokémon at Lv 50, BP prizes, a Focus Sash).
milestones.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia

steps.title: Pick a Sinnoh starter
steps.text: Turtwig, Chimchar or Piplup; a Kanto starter (weak to yours, with its Mega Stone) follows on Sabulo Island. Against Fernando's Fairy types, Piplup's Steel moves come later; Chimchar resists Fairy moves, Turtwig has the hardest time.

steps.title: Field moves
steps.text: Cut from the Seros Day-Care man, Rock Smash from Redwood, Surf from the rival in Sabulo Cave, Fly from Akuto, Rock Climb from Herschel outside Telmurk, Dive on the Precimos diving tour, Strength from Marina, Waterfall from Herschel. TMs and HMs are reusable.
steps.source: pokuniverse.com Gaia game guide; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia parts 2-20

steps.title: Collect Mega Stones
steps.text: Thirty stones are hidden around Orbtus, many up Rock Climb walls or in grottoes and temples; the Valoon Bug-Catching Contest gives Beedrillite, Pinsirite, Scizorite or Heracronite for winning with that species.

steps.title: Prepare for the league
steps.text: The Elite Four run Lv 56-58 with a Mega each, Herschel 58-60. Five items in the bag and a team in the high 50s; the order is yours.

steps.title: Return the Dusty Book
steps.text: Take the book from your desk (and the Potion in your PC) to the Ancient Rock in the Reliquia Ruins, south of town. The woman there matters later. Then the library gives the starters, and Redwood's house in Archan Town the Pokédex and Poké Balls.

steps.title: Archan Tunnel errands
steps.text: Find the boy's lost Weedle in the lower tunnel for a Soothe Bell (and an Oran Berry from him later). A one-chance Clefairy (Lv 5) sits in the shrine on B2; a Rare Candy is at the dead end.

steps.title: Chase Fernando
steps.text: Fernando runs off without giving the badge. Follow him through Seros Path into Wisp Forest; the Day-Care man (his grandfather) gives Cut. Back at the gym he hands over TM03 Charming Cry. TM10 Hidden Power is behind Hex Maniac Cadence.

steps.title: On to Aerous City
steps.text: Aerous Road has a Venonat grotto and TM12 Taunt. In the city: a Nugget at the cafe pays for the Amulet Coin, Harbor Mail behind Oppo's house buys TM34 Shock Wave, and an old woman near the bike shop gives a Revival Herb.

steps.title: Rock Smash and the mural path
steps.text: With Rock Smash, the tunnel's mural path leads to Nestpine Climb (TM21 Frustration, a Regal Stone). Backtrack for TM39 Rock Tomb in an Archan Town grotto and TM27 Return from an old lady in the tunnel. On the Climb: Shaman Yoshiro heals you after a win, a Maractus grotto, and a Fire Stone.

steps.title: Frostbite Cave
steps.text: Six floors with two ice-slide puzzles (3F and 4F); the Itemfinder lies beside the 4F grunt. Check odd minerals in the rock for hidden items. The Icy Rock for Glaceon is on 3F; Strength later opens 5F's middle ladder.

steps.title: Windmist City errands
steps.text: The Pokémon Center gives a Choice Scarf, the Ace Trainer's house an Ability Pill, the Timber Guild a Charcoal. Buy the SecretPotion (P500) at the Knick-Knack Store: it clears the Psyduck in Archan Hills later. The cable car down to Celanto Grove earns TM32 Stealth Rock.

steps.title: Bike and the S.S. Wake
steps.text: After Nina, Redwood gives a Bike Voucher (redeem it at the Aerous bike shop) and fixes his fossil machine. Beat the Sailor at the Aerous port and take the S.S. Wake to Sabulo Island.

steps.title: Sabulo Island
steps.text: Beat Fisherman Reuben for the Good Rod, get TM23 Grass Knot opposite the Pokémon Center and a Twisted Spoon on the waterfront. Lv 30 is the advice for Sabulo Tower.

steps.title: Three sea routes to Valoon
steps.text: Surf Sabulo Cross (Marowak shrine, TM31 Brick Break), Sharpgust Span (TM40 Aerial Ace) and Southsea Stretch to Valoon Way, where Nurse Olivia heals you after a battle. In Valoon Town the rangers have gone to Nemesis Cave and the gym is shut.

steps.title: Nemesis Cave and the contest
steps.text: Cross Nemesis River (Helix Fossil, Altarianite grotto) to the rangers in Nemesis Cave (Moss Rock, Old Amber, TM28 Dig, a mural). Back in town the first Bug-Catching Contest is rigged for Vernon; after it his gym opens.

steps.title: Gas Mask and the swamp
steps.text: The rival's Gas Mask gets you past the east gate. The gatehouse trades Spiritomb for a Zangoose; a pond holds a Lucky Egg; the Broken Tool in the swamp becomes a VS Seeker from the Nemesis River scientist.

steps.title: Telmurk City and its warehouses
steps.text: A thug near the Department Store gives the Storage Key for the warehouse gates: a Choice Band, TM46 Thief, the Coin Case and the Rotom room. Warehouse B's electromagnet evolves Magneton and Nosepass. Some Poké Balls are Electrode.

steps.title: Backtracking with Fly, Surf and Rock Climb
steps.text: Before Will: revive fossils at Redwood's, clear the Psyduck in Archan Hills with the SecretPotion (Kecleon and Exeggutor grottoes), fight Oppos's new Inverse Battles, and visit the Yellow Shard Meister up a wall on Aerous Road.

steps.title: Precimos Island
steps.text: TM08 Bulk Up up a wall, Ms. Move relearns moves for free, and the gym is a maze of invisible paths (four trainers on the best route). In the hotel lobby an old woman buys Relic items for a lot and another gives a Regal Stone.

steps.title: Diving tour to Edashore
steps.text: After the rival the Diving Tours give Dive. Precimos Depths (clams hold a Relic Gold and a Protein) leads to Edashore Reach and the Cosmic Caverns; TM24 Thunderbolt is by the rope bridges.

steps.title: The Meteor Festival
steps.text: Edashore's Clefairy flees into the Cosmic Caverns: approach it only from behind as it teleports. The Elder gives a Master Ball. Then the Observatory (Up-Grade), the Nursery eggs, Edamist Heights (Jaw and Sail Fossils, Glalitite, TM29 Psychic) and Gyarados Bridge.

steps.title: Atsail City
steps.text: Marina must be beaten before she takes the Tablet Idol. The Office Tower's 3F gives the Dubious Disc; the northwest house trades the Super Rod for a Dratini (Cosmic Caverns, Good Rod). Her gym needs Surf and Dive.

steps.title: Ignis Catacombs
steps.text: After Morgana, Marina opens a wall. Each Regi statue starts a battle where you play that golem against Regigigas (save first); each win clears a boulder. TM02 Dragon Claw, a Relic Crown and the Jade Orb are inside. Marina then gives Strength.

steps.title: Loamas Fields and Town
steps.text: Feed Pa's five Mareep (TM X-Scissor), find the Ampharosite barn and a Cover Fossil grotto. In town: a Sudowoodo grotto, Sgt. Stone's Mega Stones after the gym, and a rock-pushing gym (no Strength needed).

steps.title: Ikos Canyon and Town
steps.text: Sandstorm all the way: Claw and Root Fossils, five Lemonade from a Hiker. Ikos Town has the Red Shard Meister, Unown chambers and Herschel's house; he refuses to help at first.

steps.title: Victory Falls and Victory Road
steps.text: Waterfall up from Ikos Town. Nurse Florence heals after a win; a Hiker trades Tyranitarite for a Tyranitar sighting; Skull and Armor Fossils; Garchompite on Victory Road 2F past the Dive passage; Katie trades Beldum for a Ferroseed.

steps.title: After the credits
steps.text: Rimewood Forest's monster, Akuto in the Game Corner, Showtan behind the museum painting (code 1104), Cynjo at the Game Freak office and the Battle Marsh tournament. Ovarr Island and Katosurf Town are on the map but not reachable in 3.2.

secrets.text: Vincent at the Aerous art club gives an Eevee egg.
A Lv 5 Clefairy waits in a grotto in Archan Tunnel, with a Soothe Bell nearby.
Edashore Town gives a Master Ball after the Clefairy puzzle.
The Precimos hotel gives Leftovers and the Tablet Idol.
Loamas Town gives TM X-Scissor for a Mareep and Oran Berry errand; Charizardite X comes from Sgt. Stone there.
Aerous City sells an Amulet Coin for 5000; Sharpedonite is up a Rock Climb wall in the city.
Show a Slowpoke in the Windmist store for Slowbronite.
Glalitite lies in Frostbite Cave.

secrets.text: A PP Max is hidden in the Ignis Catacombs.
Atsail Bay hides a Star Piece, a Red Shard, a Zinc and a Heart Scale.
With six Pokémon in your party, the Fisherman on the Celanto Condominiums' 2F gives the Old Rod; the Super Nerd on 1F gives a Dusk Stone for a Shuppet sighting.
Beat Fisherman Reuben in his house for the Good Rod.
A Fisherman in the northwest house trades the Super Rod for a Dratini (Cosmic Caverns, Good Rod).
Choice Scarf from a woman in the Pokémon Center, Ability Pill from the Ace Trainer's house, Charcoal at the Timber Guild, King's Rock behind a boulder near the cable car.
A Lucky Egg lies at the end of the pond southwest of the first puddle clearing (Surf).
The girl in the long grass by the Rangers gives Choice Specs; a Quick Claw is across the southern pond.
A Scientist on the western beach gives Soft Sand.
After the Abomasnow is calmed, the lumberjack gives a Life Orb; Abomasite is just west.
Beat all four Winstons in a row for P10,000. A Black Belt by the lake gives a Mental Herb if you wait.
Redwood's machine (fixed after the third badge) revives fossils: Helix, Old Amber, Jaw, Sail, Cover, Claw, Root, Plume, Dome, Skull and Armor are all found in the field.

Warehouse D's lower level has a room of appliances: a Rotom turns into Heat, Wash, Frost, Fan or Mow Rotom there.
The Braille lock at the bottom says to count the stones in each pool: 4519.
On the museum's 2F, stand on the stool at the east end and enter 1104 on the painting to reach Showtan.
An old woman in the hotel lobby buys Relic items (Copper, Silver, Gold, Band, Statue, Crown) for a lot of money.
Sgt. Stone gives the Mega Stones for Charizard, Blastoise or Venusaur after the gym (Charizardite X if you already have Y).

The Psychic in the northeast corner swaps a Twisted Spoon for Alakazite; Salamencite is up a Rock Climb wall to the south.
The Hex Maniac in chamber C gives Sablenite for showing a Sableye; Mawilite is up the waterfall in the Scientist's cavern.
Lopunnite is in a shrine west of the cable car, up a Rock Climb wall.

notes.title: Gaia 3.2
notes.text: A FireRed hack (Orbtus region) with Gen I-VI species, the Fairy type, the physical/special split, Mega Evolution and ORAS move sets. No difficulty setting: it is simply harder. Saves from before 3.0 do not carry over.

notes.title: Mega Ring and stones
notes.text: The Mega Ring comes from Belle at Sabulo Tower; 30 Mega Stones are hidden around the region. Since 3.2 Mega Glalie has Refrigerate and Mega Ampharos Lightning Rod.

notes.title: Features
notes.text: Reusable TMs, running shoes indoors, Rock Climb, Dive with underwater maps, hidden grottoes and temples, a Bug-Catching Contest, move tutors, an Ability Pill.

notes.title: Few legendaries
notes.text: The Regi trio appears only in Morgana's teams and in the vision battles in the Ignis Catacombs under Apex Temple; Rayquaza (Lv 70, Emerald Peak) and Deoxys (Lv 50, Cosmic Caverns) are the catchable legends. No birds, beasts or Hoenn weather trio.
notes.source: mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 17; Allen Chingonzoh's Gaia v3.2 walkthrough (emulatorhacks.com)

notes.title: In-game trades
notes.text: Trades for Pokémon you catch: Drowzee for Abra (Nestpine), Spiritomb for Zangoose (Valoon gate), Drifloon for Elgyem (Battle Marsh), Castform for Shuckle (Edashore), Girafarig for Cacturne (Loamas Fields), Beldum for Ferroseed (Victory Falls); the Super Rod for a Dratini (Atsail). Trade evolutions all have an in-game method.
notes.source: mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia parts 4-21; Gaia team's evolution-changes spreadsheet

notes.title: The second starter
notes.text: Belle gives a Kanto starter after Sabulo Cave, holding its Mega Stone: Ivysaur (Venusaurite) if you chose Chimchar, Charmeleon (Charizardite Y) for Piplup, Wartortle (Blastoisinite) for Turtwig.
notes.source: mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 7; pokuniverse.com Gaia game guide

notes.title: Only one Eevee
notes.text: The Art Club's Egg holds the game's only Eevee. Every Eeveelution is possible: stones for five of them, the Icy Rock (Frostbite Cave) and Moss Rock (Nemesis Cave), and Sylveon by Shiny Stone.
notes.source: mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia parts 3-9; Gaia team's evolution-changes spreadsheet (Google Sheets)

notes.title: Shard Meisters
notes.text: Blue, Yellow, Red and Green Shards (from rocks and hidden spots) pay four move tutors: Blue in Valoon Town, Yellow up a wall on Aerous Road, Red in Ikos Town, Green on the sea floor reached by Dive past Sharpgust Span. Each counter also swaps 5 shards for a stone.

notes.title: Edashore Nursery eggs
notes.text: The festival stall sells eggs of Pokémon not found wild: Common P10000, Uncommon 40000, Rare 75000, Super 125000. The Super Egg is a starter from any generation, by the type you pick. Riolu comes from a Rare Egg.

notes.title: Trainers who heal
notes.text: Shaman Yoshiro (Nestpine Climb), Nurse Olivia (Valoon Way), Nurse Mercy (Cosmic Caverns) and Nurse Florence (Victory Falls) heal your team each time you beat them.

notes.title: Inverse Battles
notes.text: Proprietor Oppos's house at the south end of Archan Hills runs Inverse Battles (type matchups reversed), five in all, unlocked as you progress.
notes.source: mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia parts 3, 13; ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table

notes.title: Bug-Catching Contest
notes.text: At the Valoon Rangers HQ: one Pokémon, Park Balls, no time limit, one catch. The first contest is rigged for Vernon. Later wins give a random stone, or Beedrillite, Pinsirite, Scizorite or Heracronite for winning with that species.

notes.title: Battle Marsh Facility
notes.text: The Battle Tower of Orbtus, best left for after the league: single battles with three Pokémon at Lv 50, Battle Points for prizes such as Ability Pills, Marsh Bosses every 20 wins.
notes.source: mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 10; Allen Chingonzoh's Gaia v3.2 walkthrough (emulatorhacks.com)

notes.title: Fossils
notes.text: Redwood's machine revives Kabuto, Omanyte, Aerodactyl, Tyrunt, Amaura, Tirtouga, Anorith, Lileep, Archen, Cranidos and Shieldon; Relic Balls (Cold Storage basement) help with ancient Pokémon.

notes.title: Evolution changes
notes.text: The Gaia team's sheet lists every change: trade evolutions become levels or the Regal Stone, many Gen V-VI Pokémon evolve much earlier (Mienfoo 33, Rufflet and Vullaby 40, Larvesta 44), and Up-Grade and Dubious Disc work like stones. Anything not listed evolves as in the official games.

notes.title: Unfinished parts
notes.text: Ovarr Island and Katosurf Town are on the map, but in 3.2 the way is blocked; the credits promise Regigigas and more in a later version. Showtan, Cynjo, Akuto and the Battle Marsh are the post-game.

notes.title: Relic items
notes.text: Relic Copper, Silver, Gold, Band, Statue and Crown sit in caves and clams; sell them in the Precimos Hotel lobby for big money. Rare Bones sell for P10,000 to the collector in Seros Village.

notes.title: The rival's team
notes.text: Coulter starts with the starter strong against yours and later carries the Eeveelution that matches: Vaporeon with Infernape, Leafeon with Empoleon, Flareon with Torterra. His Altaria Mega Evolves from Ikos Canyon on.
notes.source: ROM Gaia 3.2 trainer table; mrwalkthroughs.com/pokemon-gaia part 19

notes.title: Telmurk Game Corner
notes.text: All prizes are Pokémon (1000 coins each), Porygon among them; the Coin Case is in Warehouse D and Mightyena graffiti gives 100 coins.

notes.title: Level checks
notes.text: The walkthrough's advice: Lv 10 for Fernando, 30 for Sabulo Tower, 40 for Akuto and Sid, 45 for Will, 50 for Morgana and Richter, 60 for the league.
